payload.content_brief: Create a LinkedIn post explaining why ecommerce teams miss leads when form submissions, CRM updates, and team alerts are not connected.
payload.source_context: The client helps Shopify brands automate lead intake, CRM updates, abandoned cart follow-up, and team notifications.

config.content_goal: Educate ecommerce founders about missed lead risk and introduce workflow mapping as a practical next step.

client_profile.primary_customer_type: Shopify store owners and ecommerce operators

voice_profile.style: short paragraphs, no hype, no aggressive sales language

offer_profile.primary_offer_description: A workflow that captures leads, validates payloads, removes duplicates, updates CRM records, and alerts the team.
offer_profile.main_outcome: fewer missed leads and faster follow-up

content_rules.preferred_structure: hook, problem, practical insight, soft CTA
content_rules.cta_style: soft CTA to ask for a workflow map
